column1: # The evaluation set of the second-generation collector, as scripts/gc-eval.sh
# runs it (docs/plans/garbage-collector-v2.md, The workloads; fixed with its
# weights on 2026-10-05, before any result, and not to be changed). One run per
#   group      the scores' group: a group's workloads are reduced to their
#              geometric mean, and the groups to the weighted geometric mean
#   T M P      the group's weights (the same on each of its lines); the M and
#              P columns sum to 95, a slip found after the set was fixed: the
#              scores divide by the weight present. A group weighted 0 0 0 is
#   kind       compiler: the VM on ARGUMENTS from the tree's root
#              mlton: MLton's benchmark ARGUMENTS as run-mlton-bench.sh
#                prepared it, run in tests/out/mlton-bench with its .args
#              bench: examples/benchmarks' program, ARGUMENTS its name and
#                either @normal (the manifest's normal profile) or its
#                arguments, with EXPECTED its result (shared/main.sml's input)
#              mlton-compile: the VM on ARGUMENTS in $MLTON_SOURCES (only with
#   arguments  @root is the tree's root, @out a file for the program's output,
#              @boot the compiler's own sources, @mlton the files of
#   expected   the result a bench program must print, or -
#   rounds     - for every round, or the most rounds the run gets
